field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.infectious_agent: The actual infectious agent, such as a specific bacterium.
field_descriptions.infectious_agent_class: The class of infectious agent (bacteria, prion, etc.) that causes the disease.
field_descriptions.transmission_method: How the disease spreads, either as a route or vector, for example 'direct contact', 'Aedes aegypti', etc.
